resources.string: Record who owes you and whom you owe. You can set up a payment schedule for each debt and see how much is left to pay.
Track subscriptions and repeating payments, split their cost between participants and keep an eye on their shares.
Kvity reminds you about upcoming and overdue payments. You can adjust when and how often notifications arrive.
Your data stays on your device
Everything is stored only with you: the database is encrypted, backups are available, and you can protect access with a PIN or biometrics.
